sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public') AS columns_public, (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_type='BASE TABLE') AS tables_public, (SELECT count(*) FROM empresas WHERE empresa>=9000) AS orgaos_fixture, (SELECT count(*) FROM cargos WHERE cargo>=9000) AS cargos_fixture, (SELECT count(*) FROM funcionarios WHERE numero>=9000) AS pessoas_fixture, (SELECT count(*) FROM vinculos WHERE numfunc>=9000) AS vinculos_fixture, (SELECT count(*) FROM afastamentos WHERE numfunc>=9000) AS afastamentos_fixture, (SELECT ativa FROM empresas WHERE empresa=1) AS orgao_base_ativo, (SELECT situacao FROM vinculos WHERE numfunc=1001 AND numero=1) AS vinculo_base_situacao
